## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Verona, Italy. It starts at Gardaland SEA LIFE Aquarium, Via Derna, Castelnuovo del Garda, VR, Italy.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Sea lions, red lionfish, clownfish, starfish and sharks! You'll find them all at the Gardaland SEA LIFE Aquarium, plus magical sea horses galore. Walk through the transparent sea tunnel and watch fantastical sea creatures swimming all around you. With 13 themed areas, 40 habitats and over 5000 sea creatures - this is a watery wonderland!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €10.12. It was rated 4.1 out of 5 from 730 ratings and 262 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
